guide.overview:
Royal Orchard Multan is a gated housing society on about 4,000 kanal, bounded by Multan Public School (MPS) Road, Mattital Road and Shakh-e-Madina Road, opposite Women University and the Gymkhana. Its main gate is on MPS Road, about nine minutes from Multan International Airport.

Blocks

The society is laid out in seven blocks, A to G, on either side of the Royal Boulevard that runs north from the MPS Road gate to Shakh-e-Madina Road. The boulevard meets Iqbal Boulevard and the eastern Royal Boulevard at the central roundabout, beside the grand mosque and the theme park. Blocks A, C and E are west of the boulevard; B, D, F and G are east of it, with the hospital and a park in Block F.

Plot sizes

Residential plots are 5, 10 and 12 marla and 1 and 2 kanal, with villas of 5, 10 and 12 marla and 1 kanal. Commercial plots of 2 to 10 marla line the boulevards.

Buying in Royal Orchard

Check a plot's block, size and dues with the society office at Gate 1 before you buy, and transfer it through the office. Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent in each block below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.

faqs.a: Royal Orchard is between Multan Public School Road, Mattital Road and Shakh-e-Madina Road, opposite Women University and the Gymkhana, with its main gate on MPS Road.

faqs.q: How many blocks does Royal Orchard Multan have?
faqs.a: Seven: Blocks A to G. A, C and E are west of the Royal Boulevard and B, D, F and G east of it.

faqs.q: What plot sizes are in Royal Orchard Multan?
faqs.a: Residential plots of 5, 10 and 12 marla and 1 and 2 kanal, villas of 5, 10 and 12 marla and 1 kanal, and commercial plots of 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 marla.
Royal Orchard is developed by Habib Rafiq (Pvt.) Ltd. with Royal Developers & Builders (Pvt.) Ltd.

faqs.q: How do I contact Royal Orchard Multan?
faqs.a: The office is at Gate 1, Multan Public School Road. Its UAN is 061-111-444-475 and its website is multan.royalorchard.pk.
